description: Builds an unsigned transfer transaction (native MON or ERC-20) and returns an approval URL. The user opens the URL, reviews the transaction in their Privy wallet, and approves or rejects it. After approval, poll the request with `poll_request` to retrieve the tx hash.

amount.description: Amount to send, as a decimal string e.g. "1.5".

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

to.description: Recipient — a 0x address or a Nad Name Service name like 'keone.nad' (resolved on-chain).

token.description: ERC-20 token address. Omit to send native MON.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the approval link stays valid. Defaults to 5 minutes.

name: transfer
title: Send MON or an ERC-20 token
